cohort: The study included 418 high-risk obstetric patients who had a cesarean section at a community hospital.
finding: Twenty-four-hour estimated blood loss (EBL) differed significantly among groups, with the highest EBL observed in those receiving both TXA and other uterotonic agents, and the lowest in those receiving neither.
mod_finding: The study exclusively included patients who underwent cesarean section, making the findings specific to this mode of birth.
